fields.description: Off: type the Length/Width and Sec Nos, and the weight follows. On: type the weight, and the Sec Nos follows. The same choice as "Reserve stock without dimensions" on a Material Planning row -- which of the two figures you know, and which one should be worked out for you. Only offered where a piece has dimensions to measure.
fields.label: Enter Weight, Not Pieces

fields.description: How many pieces the off-cut is. Worked out from the weight when "Enter Weight, Not Pieces" is ticked.
fields.label: Sec Nos

fields.description: Worked out from the dimensions and Sec Nos, unless "Enter Weight, Not Pieces" is ticked -- then this is what you type.
fields.label: Weight (Kg)

fields.description: Pieces of this off-cut already claimed by Material Plannings.
fields.label: Allocated Sec Nos

fields.description: Still free for another job to claim. An off-cut can be shared out in pieces, the same way a Cut Sheet is.
fields.label: Available Sec Nos

fields.description: Mandatory before the Return Excess Entry can be created (client change request Phase 5.6) -- why the actual returned Qty is what it is, especially when edited away from the auto-suggested value.
fields.label: Return Reason

fields.description: Where this off-cut comes back to. Defaults to the plan's raw-material warehouse; change it to a scrap warehouse when the piece is not reusable.
fields.label: Return Warehouse

fields.description: Copied from the source raw_materials row's own source_table -- together with Source Row, this is the STABLE reference back to the underlying Material Planning row that survives a raw_materials rebuild (unlike Source MIP Raw Material Row below, which is this MIP's own row and gets a new name on every refresh). "Round Up Sec Qty for Transfer" is the one exception -- it has no single Material Planning source row, so Source Row there is a synthetic "item_code|batch_no" key instead, just used to find-and-accumulate the same rounding-surplus row across repeated transfers. "Consolidated Excess Return Plan" is the same shape: it comes from the transfer popup's consolidated tab, which is stated per ITEM with no batch, so Source Row there is the item code itself.
fields.label: Source Table

fields.description: Row name of the Material Issue Plan Raw Material row this excess entry was auto-populated from (client change request Phase 5.3). Display/informational only -- matching uses Source Table/Source Row instead, since this MIP row's own name is regenerated on every raw_materials rebuild.
fields.label: Source MIP Raw Material Row

fields.description: Set once the batch returned from this row is reserved elsewhere via Excess Material Mapping.
fields.label: Mapped Into Material Planning

fields.description: Row name of the Material Planning Material Mapping row the batch was reserved into.
fields.label: Mapped Material Mapping Row

fields.description: Release the Material Planning reservation holding this off-cut, so its dimensions can be corrected. The off-cut goes back into the Excess Material Mapping picker for anyone to claim again.
fields.label: Unlink Claim
